description: This file defines the PrivateLinksService class, which manages creation, retrieval, updating, and deletion of private links related to event types, using various imported services and repositories.

classes.name: PrivateLinksService
classes.description: Service class for managing private links associated with event types, including creation, retrieval, update, and deletion.

methods.name: createPrivateLink
methods.description: Creates a new private link for a given event type and user, returning the link details.

methods.name: getPrivateLinks
methods.description: Retrieves all private links associated with a specific event type.

methods.name: updatePrivateLink
methods.description: Updates an existing private link identified by input data.

methods.name: deletePrivateLink
methods.description: Deletes a private link by its event type ID and link ID.
